name: Delta Reign
notes: Master total 228 as printed in the PokeCottage PDF header ('228 cards (plus promos and variants)'). Grand master total 250 is derived, not printed: master 228 + 13 promos + 9 variants listed in the PDF's Grand Master Set section. Card names/rarities cross-checked against TCGdex (api.pokemontcg.io returned 502/500 on 2026-11-26, so TCGdex was the cross-check source). Card images use the Pokemon TCG API's own image host (images.scrydex.com, pattern /pokemon/<setid>-<number>/small). Promo/variant images are null (no verified URL). Promo rarity is recorded as 'Promo' (PokeCottage lists no rarity for promos). Variant entries use the printed number form 'NNN/PPP' and carry the base card's rarity. Reverse Holo entries: TCGdex's per-card reverse flag is unpopulated for Delta Reign (all false as of 2026-11-26), so the rarity rule was used — Common/Uncommon/Rare main-set cards except the six Legendary Stadium halves (094-099, single-version Uncommons): 50 + 27 + 10 = 87, matching the printed 228 master total (141 + 87). v1.0.2 (Nov 26, 2026): Master Set redefined per Jeremy — one of each card number (incl. secret rares); holo / reverse-holo / stamp variations are Grand Master only. Master 228 -> 141; Grand unchanged at 250.
